scientific_integrity: Full proof of the count, rational enumerator and limit law provided; independent source comparison bounded; no independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to binary words with exactly three ones and alphabet order 0<1. Distinct contiguous Lyndon factors are counted, not factorization blocks. Exact finite enumeration supports but does not prove all-length statements. Unindexed equivalent earlier specialization cannot be excluded.
title: Three-marker binary words: exact distinct Lyndon-factor distribution and limit law
